en.title: Resolve GitHub review comments
en.description: Collect pull-request review threads and turn selected comments into focused code changes.
tasks: Collect pull-request review threads and turn selected comments into focused code changes.
prerequisites: A checked-out Git repository, Python, authenticated GitHub CLI, and repository access.
en.example: Use gh-address-comments. List unresolved review threads on this branch and propose fixes for the ones I select.
en.expectedResult: Numbered review threads, a focused change plan, and validation for approved fixes.
limitations: Posting replies or pushing changes affects GitHub; review the selected actions first.

zh.title: 处理 GitHub 评审意见
zh.description: 收集 PR 评审讨论，将选定意见转化为具体代码修改。
tasks: 收集 PR 评审讨论，将选定意见转化为具体代码修改。
prerequisites: 本地 Git 仓库、Python、已登录 GitHub CLI 及仓库权限。
zh.example: 请使用 gh-address-comments：列出当前分支未解决的评审讨论，为我选中的意见提出修改方案。
zh.expectedResult: 编号的评审讨论、聚焦的修改计划及获准修改的验证结果。
limitations: 回复或推送会修改 GitHub 状态，先核对要执行的动作。
